input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 imposes exclusive dealing on us: we may not participate in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products, and HDI holds the exclusive right to use our own "Deerskin" brand for a consumer web site. It runs for "the term of this Agreement", which auto-renews annually under Section 4.1, so it is not limited to 12 months, and it contains no automatic exit if HDI misses service levels or delivery dates (Section 1.6 only gives a launch-stage termination right for the whole Agreement, and our termination triggers the Section 4.2 Termination Payment). That is full-term exclusive dealing with no performance-based exit, so it fails the fallback. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 benefits us and is untouched, as is the non-exclusive Marks licence in Section 6.1's following paragraph. We replaced the offending sentence with an express non-exclusivity statement at the preferred level; narrowing to Deerskin Products for 12 months with automatic termination on service level or delivery failure remains available as a fallback.

proposal.summary: Replace Section 6.1's Company non-participation covenant and HDI's exclusive Deerskin-brand right with an express non-exclusivity statement.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We replaced Section 6.1, which barred us from any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products throughout the auto-renewing term and handed HDI an exclusive right to our own "Deerskin" brand, with an express non-exclusivity statement, consistent with our position that we take no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation. HDI's Section 6.3 covenant and its non-exclusive Marks licence are untouched; if HDI needs protection we could accept exclusivity confined to Deerskin Products for 12 months, ending automatically if HDI misses service levels or delivery dates.
